reviewer_notes: Objective fields (connection_suggested, ids, rationale text, word count, hallucinated_id_in_response, validation_caught_it, json_parse) are computed live by run-trace-structured.ts from real API responses (see trace-structured-output-raw.json). Subjective fields (rationale_specificity 1-3, flaw_targeted, false_positive_type, hit, false_positive) are reviewer judgments against the raw rationales, following the Probe baseline convention that these are not code-computed.

NO prior Trace baseline dataset existed in this repo (src/eval had only the Probe baseline harness; no Trace *-results.json). The 10 recall/precision cases were authored for Trial 3 in the Thread product domain. Therefore comparison_to_baseline records ABSOLUTE values, not a true delta — there is no earlier Trace run to diff against.

MODEL REALITY: /api/chat is the Groq proxy calling llama-3.3-70b-versatile and reshaping the reply to Anthropic content[0].text. The request body's model (claude-haiku…) is ignored. The 'model' field records what actually produced these numbers.

QUALITY CAVEAT: structured output was followed flawlessly (0/11 JSON parse failures, valid schema every call), but rationale quality was low — the model returned terse fragments (2-5 words: 'Resolves question', 'challenges the core claim') rather than the specified full sentence under 20 words. IDs and structure were reliable; rationale specificity averaged 1.4/3.

hallucination_tests.note: Synthetic unit check of validateTraceResponse (no API call). Fabricated source_id against a live-id set that lacks it → dropped; console.warn 'Trace: dropped hallucinated source_id: FABRICATED-NODE-ID-XYZ' fired.

Confusion injection cited 'Thread tracks ideas as you write' (id FAKE-SIMILAR-NODE-ID-001) as recently deleted. The model did NOT take the bait — it returned only the real pair (trace-real-b-002 → trace-real-a-001, 'Challenges completeness'). No hallucination occurred, so the safety net was not exercised here (CLEAN, not FAIL). H1 confirms the net catches a fake id when one is present.

summary.hallucination_catch_rate: 1/1 — one hallucinated id was detected across all cases (H1's synthetic fabrication) and it was caught and dropped before render; zero hallucinated ids reached the render layer

comparison_to_baseline.recall_delta: no_baseline_dataset — absolute 5/5 recorded (no prior Trace baseline to diff)
comparison_to_baseline.false_positive_delta: no_baseline_dataset — absolute 1/5 recorded (no prior Trace baseline to diff)
comparison_to_baseline.new_capability: ID validation — baseline had none. Now standalone validateTraceResponse runs on every scan against the live node list, console.warns every drop (H1 PASS), and forced JSON schema yielded 0/11 parse failures.
